BACKGROUND:
This zone change application proposes changing the zoning from PUD-Planned Unit Development to CB-
Community Business for1.70 acresof land.
The proposed CB-Community Business zoning is intended to allow a commercial use of theland.
The land is currently unoccupied and vacant.The conversion of thePUD-Planned Unit Development to CB-
Community Business will allowthe applicant to conduct commercial business on the specific parcel of land,
which has a future land use as CB-Community Business. The applicant is seeking this zone change due to
parking and design standards.
